interpretation.scope: Observed player attacks on validated Trooper and Soul Urn CItemXP episodes.
interpretation.attemptDefinition: One player-orb engagement, deduplicated across repeated damage messages from the same player.
interpretation.resolutionCreditDefinition: The player whose first observed hit received the validated shot outcome.
interpretation.competingRaceLossDefinition: A later hitter from the opposing team in a mixed-team race.
interpretation.sameTeamFollowupDefinition: A later hitter on the winning team; not treated as a competitive loss.
interpretation.importantCaution: No-shot episodes are team economy outcomes, not player choices. They are excluded from player action counts.
